en.sayed-ali-raza: He is Allāh, the True, the Manifester of Truth.
He is more True and more manifest than eyes can see.
Intellects cannot comprehend Him by fixing limits for Him since in that case to Him would be attribute shape.
Imagination cannot catch Him by fixing quantities for Him for in that case to Him would be attributed body.
He created creatures without any example, and without the advice of a counsel, or the assistance of a helper.
His creation was completed by His command, and bowed to His obedience.
It responded (to Him) and did not defy (Him). It obeyed and did not resist.
